rules.install:
# Nothing is compiled. The files are the ones Debian's rules install, with # gnulib.bundle, the repository that packages clone to get at the commit of # gnulib they pin. Left out: Debian's helpers for debhelper # (dh_gnulib_patch, gnulib-dpkg.mk) and the manual. GNULIB_DIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/gnulib" BIN_DIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin"
install -d -m 0755 "$GNULIB_DIR" "$BIN_DIR"
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" cp -a build-aux posix-modules config doc lib m4 modules top tests \ MODULES.html.sh Makefile cfg.mk check-copyright \ gnulib-tool* .gnulib-tool.py pygnulib gnulib.bundle \ "$GNULIB_DIR"
cp -a check-module "$BIN_DIR" ln -s ../share/gnulib/gnulib-tool "$BIN_DIR/gnulib-tool"
# Our stand-in for dh_gnulib_patch and the folder with its patches, which # is empty until gnulib code has to be fixed. sed "s|@DATADIR@|$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share|g" \ "$AELTRA_WORK_DIR/extra/gnulib-local/gnulib-patch" \ > "$BIN_DIR/gnulib-patch" chmod 0755 "$BIN_DIR/gnulib-patch" install -d -m 0755 "$GNULIB_DIR/aeltra/patches.d"
# As in Debian: permissions. chmod 0755 \ "$GNULIB_DIR/build-aux/config.guess" \ "$GNULIB_DIR/build-aux/config.sub" \ "$GNULIB_DIR/build-aux/gendocs.sh" \ "$GNULIB_DIR/tests/test-closein.sh" \ "$GNULIB_DIR/tests/test-posix_spawn-dup2-stdout.in.sh" \ "$GNULIB_DIR/tests/test-posix_spawn-dup2-stdin.in.sh" chmod 0644 \ "$GNULIB_DIR/doc/gendocs_template" \ "$GNULIB_DIR/m4/fflush.m4" \ "$GNULIB_DIR/modules/canonicalize-lgpl" \ "$GNULIB_DIR/modules/fflush" \ "$GNULIB_DIR/modules/fflush-tests" \ "$GNULIB_DIR/tests/test-base64.c" \ "$GNULIB_DIR/tests/test-fflush.c"
# As in Debian: files that are of no use. rm -f "$GNULIB_DIR"/*/.cvsignore "$GNULIB_DIR"/*/.gitignore \ "$GNULIB_DIR"/*/.gitattributes
